description: This file defines a set of enumeration and attribute class related to specifying key types within the PDFsharp library. Specifically, it includes the KeyType enum used for categorizing key value types in a PDF dictionary, and the KeyInfoAttribute class that allows associating metadata with such key types, including versioning and object type information.

classes.name: KeyInfoAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class for annotating key information in PDF dictionaries, including key type, version, applicable object types, and fixed value constraints.

classes.name: KeyType
classes.description: An enumeration defining various key value types and composite type flags used within the PDFsharp library, mainly for categorizing PDF object key types.
